# BookJumpr

> BookJumpr (https://bookjumpr.com) maps the books mentioned inside other books: when a character reads one, quotes one, or name-drops one. 5,382 books, 7,764 mentions.

Each mention links a book to a book it names, usually with the line from the text where it happens (quoted verbatim, not paraphrased). On the site you pick a book, see every book it mentions and every book that mentions it, and jump between them.

A book's page is at https://bookjumpr.com/#/<author-slug>/<title-slug>, e.g. https://bookjumpr.com/#/haruki-murakami/norwegian-wood. An author's page is at https://bookjumpr.com/#/<author-slug>.

## Example connections

- Norwegian Wood (Haruki Murakami) mentions The Catcher in the Rye: "No War and Peace, no Kenzaburo Oe, no Catcher in the Rye."
- Brave New World (Aldous Huxley) mentions Romeo and Juliet: "Upstairs in his room the Savage was reading Romeo and Juliet."
- Franny and Zooey (J. D. Salinger) mentions Peter Pan: "Even before the curtain goes up at 'Peter Pan,' I'm a goddam puddle of tears."
- The Catcher in the Rye (J. D. Salinger) mentions Oliver Twist: "He's carrying this copy of Oliver Twist and so's she."
- The Marriage Plot (Jeffrey Eugenides) mentions Invisible Cities: "a girl ... was smoking a clove cigarette and reading Invisible Cities"
